footer.desc: Imad Pets is your destination for quality pet products and accessories. We bring you carefully selected collections that combine quality, comfort, and style for your furry friends. Whether it's our latest arrivals or best-selling items, we make sure your shopping journey is simple, secure, and enjoyable.

about.brandStoryP1: Our brand was created out of a true passion for pets and their well-being. From the very beginning, our mission has been to provide high-quality pet products, food, and accessories that keep your furry friends happy and healthy.
about.brandStoryP2: We believe that pet care should be accessible, reliable, and enjoyable. That's why every product in our collection is carefully selected to ensure quality, safety, and comfort for your pets, giving you peace of mind with every purchase.
about.missionText: Our mission is to provide reliable and quality pet products that balance nutrition, comfort, and style, while ensuring customer satisfaction and creating a unique shopping journey for pet parents.
about.qualityText: At Imad Pets, we carefully handpick every product to ensure premium quality and safety for your pets. Our collections are crafted with attention to detail, bringing you pet care that is both reliable and trustworthy.
about.convenienceText: Enjoy a smooth and hassle-free shopping experience with our user-friendly store. From browsing the latest pet products to secure checkout, Imad Pets makes pet care shopping simple and enjoyable.
about.serviceText: Our dedicated support team is always ready to assist you. At Imad Pets, we value every customer and their furry companions, and strive to provide personalized help, making your shopping journey as seamless as possible.

product.descPlaceholder1: An e-commerce website is an online platform that facilitates the buying and selling of products or services over the internet. It serves as a virtual marketplace where businesses and individuals can showcase their products, interact with customers, and conduct transactions without the need for a physical presence. E-commerce websites have gained immense popularity due to their convenience, accessibility, and the global reach they offer.
product.descPlaceholder2: E-commerce websites typically display products or services along with detailed descriptions, images, prices, and any available variations (e.g., sizes, colors). Each product usually has its own dedicated page with relevant information.

privacy.p1: At Imad Pets, your privacy is our top priority. We are committed to protecting your personal information and ensuring that your shopping experience is safe and enjoyable. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit or make a purchase from our website.
privacy.p2: By using our website, you agree to the terms of this policy. Please take a moment to read it carefully and understand how your information is handled.
privacy.collectText: We may collect personal data such as your name, email, phone number, and shipping address. We also gather non-personal information like browser type and device data to help us improve our services and website experience.
privacy.improveText: We use collected data to enhance your shopping experience, update our collections, and personalize your journey on Imad Pets.
privacy.processText: Your personal details help us confirm orders, handle deliveries, and provide support related to your purchases.
privacy.securityText: We implement strict security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, misuse, or alteration.
privacy.storedText: Your information is stored securely and is only accessible to authorized personnel. We never share your personal data with third parties, except when required to complete your order or comply with legal obligations.
privacy.encryptionText: We also use encryption and security tools to safeguard payment information and ensure your transactions are safe.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data. To exercise these rights, please contact us at sassianasdev@gmail.com.
privacy.questions: For any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:
